newsitem.title: USA: IHOP Corp completes $35 mln notes funding.
newsitem.headline: IHOP Corp completes $35 mln notes funding.

text.p: IHOP Corp said it had completed funding of $35 million of unsecured senior notes due 2008.
The company said in a statement released on Monday it had privately placed the notes with a group of accredited investors with Bank of America NT&SA acting as the placement agent.
The proceeds will be used to fund capital expenditures, refinance existing debt, and for general corporate purposes, it said.
IHOP develops, franchises and operates restaurant chain International House of Pancakes.
